rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Bright and Breezy
rows.Origin:
Bred by Colin Dickson (1956-....) (United Kingdom, before 2011).
Introduced in New Zealand by Amoré Roses in 2021 as 'Bright and Breezy'.
rows.Bloom: Red, yellow undertones, yellow reverse. Moderate fragrance. Double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, matte, dark green, dense foliage.

Height: 35" to 43" (90 to 110cm). Width: up to 2' (up to 60cm).
rows.Notes: Parentage is Atlantic Star x Little Miss Sunshine according to Member comments
